target.supportedDevices: Apple Silicon Macs, MacBook Air M1 and newer

bundledComponents.name: cli-package
bundledComponents.source: src-tauri/resources/cli-package/ (Verboo CLI + Node dependency closure, copied by scripts/verify/copy-cli-resource.mjs)

bundledComponents.name: portable-pty
bundledComponents.source: src-tauri/Cargo.toml dependencies.portable-pty (Rust native terminal module, compiled into the Tauri binary)

externalRuntime.name: Git
externalRuntime.reason: Useful for repository-aware coding tasks, but not required to open, authenticate, or chat.

externalRuntime.name: Apple Command Line Tools
externalRuntime.reason: Useful when a project needs git/build tooling. The app must not install it automatically.

externalRuntime.name: Node.js
externalRuntime.reason: The bundled cli-package CLI is JavaScript (engines.node >=22.0.0 in src-tauri/resources/cli-package/package.json) and runs through a system Node resolved by src-tauri/src/services/node_runtime.rs (Homebrew, nvm, fnm, Volta, or PATH). The packaged app does not ship a Node runtime. User-installed Node is left untouched.

externalRuntime.name: Global @verboo/code CLI
externalRuntime.reason: The packaged app runs the bundled cli-package. User-installed CLI versions are left untouched.

blocksOn: missing bundled native modules required by the app
